summary: Re-confirmed the p3-259 split values (100% reservable on Iowa ReserveAmerica Apr 1-Nov 15 until 10 pm day of arrival, closed Nov 16-Mar 31, 3-month window, showers closed for the season). Added vault toilets ('flush and non-flush restrooms'). Lakeview stands. Pin is the site centroid.
flags: SEPARATE CAMPGROUND confirmed: the DNR gives the southern unit its own access 'off County Road F-28 by Fifth Street in Solon', versus the northern unit 'at the end of County Road F-16'; ReserveAmerica lists 'Primitive Campground-South' as its own loop. p3-259 measured the two 3.3 km apart.

FIT: 45 of the 52 non-electric sites take 25-30 ft (26 at 30 ft, 19 at 25 ft), 7 are 20 ft; every one is typed 'RV Site, Tent Site, Trailer Site'. No campground-wide length rule found. sites.max_rig_ft could be 30 (RA max vehicle length), not written here because the per-site list was read in p3-259, not live today.

WATERFRONT lakeview stands. The GIS points put the loops on a wooded slope above the lake's south arm; the southern sites (91-96) sit on both sides of the campground's own loop road, 25-60 m from the water across the fishing-pier lawn, and the east sites (83-84) face a shallow, algae-covered arm through trees. Six official RA site photos (posts 48-51, 56-57, 60-61; the post numbers do not match RA's 45-96) show the lake across open lawn or through bare trees. Not on-water: the loop road and the pier day-use lawn are between.
ReserveAmerica bulletin: showers and modern restrooms at both campgrounds are closed for the season; hydrants on until November 15 (already in facilities.note).
